Cost 2 Zeal

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

A delayed-onset curse that ticks mental damage each turn.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC. On a failure, nothing happens immediately, but at the start of each of its turns for the duration it takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage with no save (@Damage[5d6[mental]] on a critical failure). The effect ends early if the target dies or you dismiss it as a free action.
